child_tool_info.description: Align supplied DNA with BV-BRC MSA progressiveMauve; retain all XMFA blocks, native strand/position correspondence and coverage, separately from its first-block FASTA.
child_tool_info.instructions: Align the selected DNA with aligner=progressiveMauve and alphabet=dna using the ordinary MSA input branch, without an active selected-segment request. Acquire the complete native XMFA. The retained producer writes a separate FASTA derivative of only the first block and relabels its rows using staged input-header order; that derivative is not a whole-genome alignment. Select mauve_blocks for the native document and mauve_first_block_projection for the derivative; keep their original relationship explicit. The declared mauve_xmfa_v1 reader preserves all blocks, zero/omitted members, strands and literal characters. Coordinates distinguish aligned columns, native member positions, byte-verified staged source records and separately evidenced original member occurrences. Supply actual source bytes and file/entry/argv order for source coverage. FASTA and raw DNA source readers are bound; GenBank and DNAstar source extraction remains unavailable. Choose represented, multi_member_block or cooccupied_column coverage explicitly. Preserve interval unions, overlapping placements and denominators; do not add block spans or infer an original genome map from a native label. Use the native dna/protein alphabet and real selected aligner/strategy; a legacy ClustalW description or RNA label does not establish a current route. Native preparation does not inject defaults into the original request. Preserve the requested and observed settings separately. For ref_type=string, the retained producer trims outer whitespace and writes ref_string directly into input.fasta without adding a header; retain its actual FASTA and prove the reference row. For feature_id, genome_id or first references, retain the actual fetched/selected row and its identity evidence. A reference label alone cannot prove correspondence. Acquire the actual aligned FASTA, native .snp.tsv frequency table and consensus FASTA as distinct artifacts. The table is a column-frequency table, not per-member variant calls. Native score is distinct from entropy in bits and from separately calculated reference differences. Preserve terminal gaps, exact denominators and the native consensus; do not force a consensus when no strict majority exists. An available FastTree Newick is a separate selected artifact. Its name does not prove model, support method or units; midpoint rooting is not biological rooting. Comparisons with organismal relationships need the supplied tree and actual tip mapping. An alignment or tree alone does not supply a function assignment. Where this entry exposes a launch route, commission the existing launch episode and its selected API child with the original job and constraints. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the selected application, parameters, input bindings and output destination without submitting. Input transfer uses separately selected workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload operations when needed. submit performs the selected primitive AppService.start_app2 call and retains its actual request, response and task identity. Use the generic resource monitoring task with selected status/query_tasks and task_info stdout or stderr observations. Preserve native state, observation time and logs; process liveness does not establish throughput. The episode chooses further observations and repairs; there is no fixed polling cadence or automatic retry. The existing results episode selects task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download as needed for the original task's actual files. A filename, HTML report or directory entry does not prove numerical format or original producer-byte identity. Preparation, transfer and task receipts do not receive invented annotation-confidence scores. This configured API route does not establish live authentication, deployment or local/HPC scientific execution. Select exact artifact roles, analysis-local slots, native reader formats and dialects, populations, calculation requests and the parent's typed return before acquisition. A bundle role selects the exact original output requirement's role; do not infer it from a filename. Supply source-backed member/row, feature/genome, function/taxon, transformation and category associations through scientific_inputs and supplied_metadata. Additional files need their original supplied_contents bindings and complete bytes. Source labels inside JSON do not authenticate a claim. The adapter's native parsers and metadata extractors fill the numerical sheet; separate deterministic calculators consume that sheet and explicit parameters. Those functions perform no acquisition, job, resource or model operation. Use the finite requested_form_schema selectors for the needed native measurements, calculated components, selected positions/tests and qualifications. Keep full bytes, associations, sheets and component sets internally, including valid partial work and unrelated failed analyses. Recalculate saved sheets with changed explicit parameters without reacquiring data or rewriting historical observations. Return only the original requested typed facts through the bvbrc_alignment return sources. No extra model call restates recorded facts; no full sheet or parent yield history is inserted into the child's instructions.

adaptations: Real marginal credit responses pass into the fit without integer coercion
Completed Episode acquisitions condition on observation; no failure/usability model
A fresh original fitter cold-fits the entire score history each turn
Original numeric bands and delta/Laplace curvature approximation are retained
Signed corrections use paired gain/loss marks at the same action ranks inside the estimator
After an observed loss, component alpha/2 bands subtract to an approximate signed net interval
limitations: The fractional kernel is not a continuous-response probability density
Uncertainty assumes the working model and is not coverage calibrated
Credit units affect effective information and must remain fixed within an Episode
Rank-decay extrapolation assumes declining yield; late discoveries can violate it
No failed-attempt probability is estimated from completed-only acquisitions
The inherited local optimizer has no global optimum or convergence certificate; bands can jump across history lengths
Before any observed loss the original nonnegative model assumes zero loss; this is an explicit working-model assumption
Gain/loss interval subtraction is not coverage calibrated; Bonferroni allocation cannot calibrate the underlying Laplace approximation
